cartes.texte: Étape 1Logarithme des deux membres⟦(3^{x - 1})^{3} = 9 \cdot 3^{x - 2}⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦\log((3^{x - 1})^{3}) = \log(9 \cdot 3^{x - 2})⟧(log des deux membres)⟦\iff⟧⟦\log((3^{x - 1})^{3}) = \log(9) + \log(3^{x - 2})⟧(log(ab) = log a + log b)⟦\iff⟧⟦(3x - 3) \cdot \log(3) = \log(9) + (x - 2) \cdot \log(3)⟧(log(a^A) = A · log(a))⟦\iff⟧⟦3x \cdot \log(3) - 3\log(3) = x \cdot \log(3) + \log(9) - 2\log(3)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x \cdot 2\log(3) = \log(3) + \log(9)⟧⟦\iff⟧⟦x = \frac{\log(3) + \log(9)}{2\log(3)}⟧(car ⟦2\log(3) \neq 0⟧)⟦\phantom{x} = \frac{\log(27)}{\log(9)}⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\log(3) + \log(9) = \log(3 \cdot 9)⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{\log(3) + \log(9)} = \log(27)⟧⟦2\log(3) = \log(3^{2})⟧(propriétés des logarithmes)⟦\phantom{2\log(3)} = \log(9)⟧
Solution⟦S = \left\{\frac{\log(27)}{\log(9)}\right\}⟧Contrôlez à la calculatrice : ⟦x = \frac{\log(27)}{\log(9)} = \frac{3}{2}⟧.
